fields.Name: Realtime
fields.Description: Streaming, full-duplex, tool-calling models that own the listen-reason-speak loop themselves (e.g. Gemini Live, GPT Realtime). Used by the Realtime agent type for low-latency, bidirectional voice (and later video) conversations. Resolved through the ClassFactory by AIModelType + DriverClass, the same as LLM/Embeddings/Image models, but exposed via the BaseRealtimeModel primitive rather than request/response BaseLLM.

fields.Name: Speech to Text
fields.Description: Models that transcribe recorded audio into text (e.g. Whisper). The inverse of TTS: audio in, text out. Exposed through the BaseAudioGenerator primitive's SpeechToText method and resolved through the ClassFactory by AIModelType + DriverClass, the same as LLM/Embeddings/Image models. Distinct from Realtime, which owns a live bidirectional audio loop rather than transcribing a finished recording. Filing a transcription model under TTS would invert its modalities, so a caller resolving by type would hand audio to a model the catalog claims turns text into audio.

fields.Name: STT
fields.Description: Duplicate of 'Speech to Text' seeded by the v5 baseline. Removed so a model type can act as a hard floor without silently splitting speech-to-text models across two rows; references are repointed to 'Speech to Text' by V202609231300__v6.2.x__Repoint_STT_Model_Type_To_Speech_To_Text.sql.

fields.Name: Decision
fields.Description: Models that answer typed questions about a state with probabilities instead of text: a Likelihood (the probability a statement is true), a Choice (one option from a described set, with a probability per option) or a Score (a position on an ordered rubric, with a probability per level). Used for fast judgments such as routing, gating, relevance and evaluation. Exposed through the BaseDecision primitive and resolved through the ClassFactory by AIModelType + DriverClass, the same as LLM/Embeddings/Reranker models. A driver is either a native decision model, which returns typed answers with nothing to parse, or LLMDecision, which answers the same questions with a chat model through an MJ prompt. Per-model limits (questions per call, options per Choice, levels per Score, state size) belong in the Decision section of ModelConfiguration.
